definitions.explanation: A vertical section of a newspaper, magazine, or webpage.
A designated space on a form for entering information.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}のスポーツ{欄|らん}を{読|よ}む。
examples.english: Read the sports section of the newspaper.

examples.japanese: {住所|じゅうしょ}{欄|らん}に{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in the address field.

examples.japanese: コメント{欄|らん}に{意見|いけん}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote my opinion in the comments section.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}の{読者投稿|どくしゃとうこう}{欄|らん}は{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: The reader submissions column in this magazine is popular.

examples.japanese: {該当|がいとう}する{欄|らん}にチェックを{入|い}れてください。

notes:
{欄|らん} refers to a designated section, column, or field — whether in print media or on forms. It is commonly used as a suffix attached to what the section is for.

FORM/DOCUMENT FIELDS:
- {住所|じゅうしょ}{欄|らん}: address field
- {氏名|しめい}{欄|らん}: name field
- {記入|きにゅう}{欄|らん}: entry/input field
- {備考|びこう}{欄|らん}: remarks column
- {該当|がいとう}する{欄|らん}: applicable field/box

MEDIA SECTIONS:
- {投書|とうしょ}{欄|らん}: letters to the editor
- コメント{欄|らん}: comments section (also used for web)
- {読者|どくしゃ}{欄|らん}: reader section
- スポーツ{欄|らん}: sports section

USAGE:
In everyday life, {欄|らん} is most often encountered when filling out forms: {欄|らん}に{記入|きにゅう}する (to fill in a field). Online, コメント{欄|らん} is widely used for website comment sections.
